title: What kind of file is this?
description:
Recognise file types from their first bytes, the way operating systems do.

```
89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A ... -> PNG image
25 50 44 46 ...             -> PDF document
50 4B 03 04 ...             -> ZIP archive (also .docx, .jar)
7F 45 4C 46 ...             -> ELF program (Linux)
4D 5A ...                   -> Windows program (.exe)
48 65 6C 6C 6F              -> unknown (looks like text: "Hello")
```
hints: `all(32 <= b < 127 for b in data)` checks for printable text.
requirements: A table of signatures (bytes) and names; check whether the data starts with each.
Work on `bytes` values; build test data with `bytes.fromhex`.
If nothing matches and every byte is printable ASCII, say it looks like text.
stretch: Read the first 16 bytes of real files on your computer with `open(path, "rb").read(16)`.
